title: Authority boundaries and bypass risk
summary: CMS/Story owns approved meaning; Institutional Policy and identity own operational permission; scoped publication and SocialLibrary control outbound; provider adapters do not authorize.
invariants: The lower-level SocialLibrary~execute and SocialPublicationService are public, permitting bypass if application developers expose them instead of strict SocialScopedPublicationService. Must close structurally before production.
Registration, capability discovery and provider acknowledgement are not grants.
Advertising, direct outreach, marketplace commerce and moderation each require separate effectful authority.
